data.title: US refusing to give Sudan's de facto leader visa for UN: diplomatic sources, UN
data.description: KHARTOUM - Washington is refusing to give Sudan's de facto leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, a visa to travel to New York to address the UN General Assembly, two diplomatic sources told AFP Tuesday, a moved confirmed by the UN.

data.title: Trump threatens Iran with 'hell' but unveils fresh talks
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump told the United Nations on Tuesday he was deciding whether to "annihilate" Iran -- before revealing that US and Iranian officials had held talks for the first time in months.

data.title: Trump signs security deal with Greenland, Denmark at UN
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump signed a security deal Tuesday with the leaders of Greenland and Denmark, cooling temperatures after his contentious calls to acquire the autonomous Danish territory.

data.title: Macron urges world to choose UN over 'law of the jungle'
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - French President Emmanuel Macron called Tuesday for countries to recommit to international laws and the UN system over a resurgent "law of the jungle."

data.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro turns scandal into poll gains
data.description: SAO PAULO - Despite being caught up in an explosive financial scandal that has dominated Brazil’s election campaign, candidate Flavio Bolsonaro has gained ground with less than two weeks to go before the vote.

data.title: UN chief says Big Oil treats atmosphere as ‘open sewer’
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - Major global oil companies are treating the atmosphere like an “open sewer,” the outgoing United Nations chief Antonio Guterres said on Tuesday in a withering attack on the energy industry at the UN’s high-level meeting.

data.title: 11 hurt as teen opens fire outside school in western Turkey
data.description: TURGUTLU, Turkey - A teenager opened fire outside a high school in western Turkey on Tuesday, wounding 11 pupils, before being detained in the country’s third such shooting in six months, officials said.

data.title: Tunisia says summer of 2026 hottest on record
data.description: TUNIS - Tunisia’s summer this year was its hottest on record, the country’s weather authority said on Tuesday, following multiple heatwaves, water shortages and power cuts.

data.title: Questions mount about Trump Jr’s Russian-financed wedding
data.description: WASHINGTON - A Republican US senator has called for Donald Trump Jr to be subpoenaed over a Russian oligarch close to Vladimir Putin helping bankroll lavish celebrations for the president’s son’s wedding.

data.title: Trump to use UN speech to defend Iran war
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - US President Donald Trump was preparing to use his an address to the United Nations to argue that the war with Iran prevented Tehran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and to tout what he sees as progress toward peace and a global order increasingly aligned with American interests, according to a White House official.

data.title: Student opens fire outside school in Turkey, 11 pupils wounded
data.description: ANKARA — A student ​opened fire in front of their high school in Turkey's ​western province of Manisa early ‌on Tuesday, wounding at least 11 other pupils, Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said.

data.title: Missing F-35 fighter parts 'not sensitive', says Australian minister
data.description: SYDNEY — Missing F-35 fighter parts diverted from Australia to Hong Kong are not "sensitive", Defence Minister Richard Marles said Tuesday, confirming Canberra was helping to investigate the incident.

data.title: Iran ready to reopen Strait of Hormuz if US eases military pressure and lifts blockade
data.description: NEW YORK — Iran can reopen the Strait of Hormuz ​within seven days ‌if the United States eases military pressure and lifts its blockade on Iranian ports, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Tuesday.

data.title: Macron holds ‘constructive’ talks with Trump
data.description: NEW YORK - French President Emmanuel Macron said he had “very constructive” talks with his US counterpart Donald Trump on the conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine.

data.title: Cambodia showcases scams crackdown with global conference
data.description: PHNOM PENH - Cambodia showed off a shuttered scam compound complete with counterfeit cash and a fake police station this week ahead of a global conference intended to burnish its anti-fraud credentials.

data.title: Six-year-old Chinese girl sets world record with Rubik's Cube
data.description: BEIJING - A six-year-old Chinese girl has set a new women's world record for solving a 3x3 Rubik's Cube in just over four seconds, state media reported.

data.title: G7 leaders condemn Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
data.description: RIYADH — Group of Seven (G7) nations called on Yemen's Houthis Tuesday to halt strikes on Saudi Arabia, offering a show of solidarity with Riyadh as the Tehran-backed fighters have added a new threat to the Middle East war.

data.title: US imposes visa curbs on 32 people linked to Prince Group
data.description: WASHINGTON - The ​US ​State ‌Department on Monday imposed visa restrictions on ​32 ⁠individuals connected to the ‌Prince Group, accusing them of ⁠playing a role in defrauding Americans, according to ​a statement.

data.title: Google data centre sparks protests in Austria
data.description: LINZ (AUSTRIA) - In the Austrian town of Kronstorf, a planned Google data centre promises investment, jobs and a place on the digital map -- but residents are not convinced.
